dashboard_trackers.notes: Post-cutoff results were policy commentary rather than a new safeguards decision, a qualifying high-enrichment production threshold, weaponization order, detonation or NPT withdrawal. dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR

Tehran says it is not seeking resumed direct talks, while intermediaries remain active. Saudi Arabia says drones aimed at petroleum sites came from Iran-backed groups in Iraq and reserves the right to respond; no fresh direct U.S.-Iran strike or verified new damage appeared after the prior scan. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.notes: During a Lebanon visit, UN human rights chief Volker Türk called for Israeli forces to leave and for house demolitions to stop. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Post-cutoff results added commentary on Greek air-defence procurement and Turkish regional diplomacy, not a verified Turkish combat entry, unusual concentration, long-range weapons event or official atomic-weapons threshold. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Search operations after suspected drone sightings near the international border and Line of Control remain the latest operational fact. dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: A new Rawadari retrospective documents Pakistani attacks since December 2024, while current resistance claims and Pakistan militant violence remain distinct from interstate escalation. No fresh state-on-state strike, sustained border clash, crossing closure or unusual force movement was corroborated. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: The emergency UN Security Council coverage added details on strikes against ports, ships and diplomatic premises while reciprocal drone attacks continued. The high-intensity war persists, but no new strategic-posture change or direct NATO combat entry was verified after the prior scan. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Russia's Bucharest embassy denied deliberately targeting Romania, said the expulsion of its staff member would not go unanswered and warned that Romanian cross-border air-defence action would amount to direct involvement in combat. Romania separately issued a 46-minute public alert after detecting a group of air targets near the Ukrainian river border, without reporting another Romanian incursion. No NATO collective consultation or Russian retaliatory step was announced. Raw 58; coupled 68

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Post-cutoff results were commentary rather than a new PLA operation. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh stories repeat Ukraine's claim that Russia may receive 30,000 more North Korean personnel and the Kremlin's rejection. No independently verified movement, launcher relocation, operational firing or prohibited detonation appeared. Raw 18; coupled 18
